impact: Worst-verdict-wins is computed from the two raw verdicts before the cross-review round, so if one provider's harsher verdict rests entirely on findings the other provider disputes as false positives, the merged verdict stays harsh. Deliberate design (Claude synthesizes downstream) but undocumented — a caller reading only verdict gets the pre-adjudication picture. At minimum document this in README/tool description; optionally soften verdict when all of the harsher provider's exclusive findings are disputed.
resolution: Fixed in T-030 as a documented contract (no verdict recompute — synthesis is the caller's job by design). Code comments at combineCode/combinePlan verdict lines, plus notes in README (deliberate-deep section), the MCP server instructions, and both review_plan/review_code tool descriptions stating: under deliberate-deep the verdict reflects both providers' independent reviews and is not recomputed from cross-review adjudications; deliberation.divergent[].adjudication is advisory input for the caller's synthesis.
title: Merged verdict computed before cross-review — adjudication never feeds back into verdict
